infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan a Devcon Follow social profile QR code.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Check in to an organizer-approved Devcon venue and share an optional, temporary location reading.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Share a short-lived anonymous Bluetooth token with nearby opted-in Devcon Follow attendees while discovery is on.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Devcon Follow to scan social profile QR codes.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow a temporary venue check-in and optional nearby discovery.
